entities.name: Rice NTRC Q70G58
observations: Exact 100% sequence match to reviewed Oryza sativa subsp. japonica thioredoxin reductase NTRC; sequence length 515 aa.

NADPH-dependent thioredoxin reductase (EC 1.8.1.9) with both thioredoxin-reductase and thioredoxin activities; annotated electron donor to plastidial 2-Cys peroxiredoxin in chloroplast peroxide scavenging.
Annotated to bind one FAD per subunit and homodimerize under reducing conditions.
Annotated plastid/chloroplast localization; reference features include a chloroplast transit peptide at residues 1–45 and C-terminal thioredoxin domain at residues 377–515.
Sequence-derived estimates: molecular mass 56,150 Da; theoretical pI 6.06; GRAVY −0.256. Estimates do not account for processing or modifications.

entities.name: FAD CHEBI:57692
observations: UniProt reference annotation records one FAD cofactor bound per NTRC subunit.

entities.name: Chloroplast peroxide defense
observations: Rice NTRC is annotated as an NADPH-dependent electron donor to plastidial 2-Cys peroxiredoxin BAS1 in hydrogen peroxide scavenging in chloroplasts, particularly in the dark.
